title: SF50 (2021, First Special): Firearm purchase, ownership, possession, or carrying authorization denial based solely on the basis that the person is enrolled as a patient in the medical cannabis registry prohibition

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/1/SF/50/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed (2021 special session; no date given in the source); no votes recorded. Treated as single: every part decides gun eligibility; cannabis appears only as the status protected. Sections 1-4 add definitions. Sec. 7 also strikes only an 'or' and a period (formatting).

operative_text:
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, subd. 1): The use of medical cannabis by a patient enrolled in the registry program does not constitute the unlawful use of a controlled substance under this item;
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, subd. 1): Participation as a patient in the registry program does not disqualify the person from possessing firearms and ammunition under this section.
Section 6 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 6): (f) A sheriff shall not deny an application for a permit to carry solely because the applicant is a patient enrolled in the registry program and uses medical cannabis for a qualifying medical condition.
Section 7 (Minn. Stat. 624.7142, subd. 1): (7) when the person is enrolled as a patient in the registry program, uses medical cannabis, and knows or has reason to know that the medical cannabis used by the person has the capacity to cause impairment.
Section 9 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152): (a) A person may not be denied the right to purchase, own, possess, or carry a firearm solely on the basis that the person is a patient in the registry program.
Section 9 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152): (b) A state or local agency may not access a database containing the identities of patients in the registry program to obtain information for the purpose of approving or disapproving a person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
Section 9 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152): (d) A state or local agency may not inquire about a person's status as a patient in the registry program for the purpose of approving or disapproving the person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
